metadata.question: Does the surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020, compare to long-term records for the same month?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Region: Utah polygon from TIGER/2018/States.
- Primary dataset: NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E (surface soil moisture, 9 km), fallback: NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP (36 km), then ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY (volumetric_soil_water_layer_1).
- Periods: Aug 2020 (2020-08-01 to 2020-09-01) vs long-term August climatology (month=8, exclude year=2020).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- For SMAP: mask by retrieval_qual_flag==0 if available, and constrain values to [0,1].
- For ERA5: no cloud mask; clamp [0,1] to avoid invalids.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check ImageCollection sizes; if zero after trying all datasets => C1.
- Compute valid pixel counts; if zero => C2.
- If means are null/NaN or outside [0,1] => C3.
- Compare Aug 2020 mean vs climatology mean: lower => A, else => B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function maskSMAP(img) {
  // Mask by retrieval_qual_flag == 0 if present; also constrain [0,1]
  var hasQ = img.bandNames().contains('retrieval_qual_flag');
  var qMask = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasQ, img.select('retrieval_qual_flag').eq(0), ee.Image(1)));
  var sm = img.select('soil_moisture');
  var valid = sm.gte(0).and(sm.lte(1));
  return sm.updateMask(qMask).updateMask(valid);
}

function prepareSMAPCollections(datasetId, utah, augStart, augEnd) {
  var baseAll = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId);
  var augCol = baseAll.filterDate(augStart, augEnd);
  var climCol = baseAll
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.not(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')))
    .filterDate('2015-01-01', '2025-01-01');
  return { augCol: augCol, climCol: climCol, type: 'smap', band: 'soil_moisture', id: datasetId };
}

function prepareERA5Collections(utah, augStart, augEnd) {
  var id = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY';
  var baseAll = ee.ImageCollection(id);
  var augCol = baseAll.filterDate(augStart, augEnd).select('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1');
  var climCol = baseAll
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.not(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')))
    .filterDate('1981-01-01', '2025-01-01')
    .select('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1');
  return { augCol: augCol, climCol: climCol, type: 'era5', band: 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1', id: id };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
    const utah = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Utah')).geometry();
    const augStart = '2020-08-01';
    const augEnd = '2020-09-01';

    // 2. Dataset candidates
    const candidates = [];
    candidates.push(prepareSMAPCollections('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E', utah, augStart, augEnd));
    candidates.push(prepareSMAPCollections('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP', utah, augStart, augEnd));
    candidates.push(prepareERA5Collections(utah, augStart, augEnd));

    let chosen = null;
    let augCount = 0;
    let climCount = 0;

    for (let cand of candidates) {
      const s1 = await getInfo(cand.augCol.size());
      const s2 = await getInfo(cand.climCol.size());
      if (s1 > 0 && s2 > 0) {
        chosen = cand;
        augCount = s1;
        climCount = s2;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('Aug2020 Images: 0');
      console.log('Clim-Aug Images: 0');
      console.log('Dataset: None');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    let augImg, climImg, scaleVal, dsLabel = chosen.id;
    if (chosen.type === 'smap') {
      augImg = chosen.augCol.map(maskSMAP).mean();
      climImg = chosen.climCol.map(maskSMAP).mean();
      scaleVal = 9000;
    } else { // era5
      // Clamp to [0,1] to avoid invalids
      augImg = chosen.augCol.mean().clamp(0, 1);
      climImg = chosen.climCol.mean().clamp(0, 1);
      scaleVal = 11000;
    }

    // 4. Pixel counts and stats
    const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
    const augDict = augImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers,
      geometry: utah,
      scale: scaleVal,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    });
    const climDict = climImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers,
      geometry: utah,
      scale: scaleVal,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    });

    const meanKey = chosen.band + '_mean';
    const countKey = chosen.band + '_count';

    const augRes = await getInfo(ee.Dictionary(augDict));
    const climRes = await getInfo(ee.Dictionary(climDict));

    const augMean = augRes ? augRes[meanKey] : null;
    const augValid = augRes ? augRes[countKey] : 0;
    const climMean = climRes ? climRes[meanKey] : null;
    const climValid = climRes ? climRes[countKey] : 0;

    console.log(`Dataset: ${dsLabel}`);
    console.log(`Aug2020 Images: ${augCount}`);
    console.log(`Clim-Aug Images: ${climCount}`);

    if (!augValid || !climValid) {
      console.log(`Aug2020 ValidPx: ${augValid || 0}`);
      console.log(`Clim-Aug ValidPx: ${climValid || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (augMean === null || climMean === null || !isFinite(augMean) || !isFinite(climMean)) {
      console.log(`Aug2020 Mean: ${augMean}`);
      console.log(`Clim-Aug Mean: ${climMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Validation: ensure values in reasonable [0,1]
    if (augMean < 0 || augMean > 1 || climMean < 0 || climMean > 1) {
      console.log(`Aug2020 Mean: ${augMean}`);
      console.log(`Clim-Aug Mean: ${climMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = augMean - climMean;
    const pct = climMean !== 0 ? (delta / climMean) * 100.0 : null;

    console.log(`Aug2020 Mean: ${augMean.toFixed(4)} (ValidPx: ${augValid})`);
    console.log(`Clim-Aug Mean: ${climMean.toFixed(4)} (ValidPx: ${climValid})`);
    if (pct !== null && isFinite(pct)) {
      console.log(`Delta: ${delta.toFixed(4)} (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Delta: ${delta.toFixed(4)} (pct: n/a)`);
    }

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (augMean < climMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
